body_systems.system: Ear, nose, mouth, throat and neck

data_model.complaints: Each complaint has an ordered differential_ids array. Resolve each ID against the differentials array.
data_model.differentials: A first-seen, deduplicated registry. IDs are stable within this file; first_seen_in_complaint_id records the insertion point.
data_model.deduplication: Differential names are reused when their normalized names match (Unicode normalization, case folding, and whitespace normalization). Exact clinical synonyms with different wording may remain separate.
data_model.ordering: Complaints are ingested in the included head-to-toe/system order. For every complaint, its record is appended first; each differential is then checked against the existing registry and either reused or added. Differential order within a complaint is editorial and is not a probability ranking.

scope_and_safety.scope: Broad educational index of common, important, time-critical, uncommon, medication-related, infectious, structural, and functional causes across body systems and ages.
scope_and_safety.limitations: No finite index can contain literally every possible complaint or cause. This is a curated, non-exhaustive starting library; phrasing, age, pregnancy, examination, tests, and local epidemiology change the differential.
scope_and_safety.clinical_notice: Not a diagnosis, triage tool, or substitute for professional medical care. The listed differentials are unranked and not exhaustive. Do not delay urgent evaluation for severe or rapidly worsening symptoms. Clinician review is required before clinical deployment.
scope_and_safety.content_note: The entries are educationally curated and should be independently verified against current clinical references before use in patient care or research.
